provenance.status: assistant re-review of the low-reasoning runs under the user-approved advisor rubric; not per-case user adjudication or ground truth
provenance.review_method: A read-only subagent reviewed this partition from source facts and captured observations without seeing prior labels; the main assistant reconciled the recommendations with the sources. A separate subagent reviewed the historical high-reasoning partition. Subagent participation is not independent human validation.
provenance.rubric: Judge each generated consultation need independently; do not transfer roles or question labels from the high-reasoning runs. Direct requires personal work or current responsibility on this specific need. An advisor may explain a related real process/work item to help understand the need or approach the appropriate practitioner; area expertise is not required, but an explainable source-to-need bridge is. Titles, mentions, and manager/remit-only ties do not establish advisor expertise; routing retains its separate evidence requirements. Judge contact usefulness, direct support, and question premises independently of question format. Open conditional inquiries do not assert that a control or requirement exists; questions assuming undocumented contents, duties, or findings are unsupported. Impact hypotheses are not false merely because they are absent from the idea or work sources. Card questions are the captured neutral replacements, scored independently of the model-generated asks. Null leaves uncertain dimensions unscored.
